arguments.value: This agreement says MMI will manufacture and manage production and related services for Dragon Systems' products on a turnkey basis, initially for three products, with prices set in attached price sheets. MMI is responsible for receiving and managing materials, sourcing supplies, production, delivery, inventory, and financial services, and must meet agreed service levels. Dragon Systems can reject services that do not meet specifications, but acceptance is assumed if no notice is given within 60 days after delivery. Dragon Systems must pay MMI in U.S. dollars within 30 days after delivery or invoicing, with prices generally excluding shipping, insurance, VAT, and certain import duties; MMI may also charge a fee for inventory older than 90 days. MMI warrants its work for six months and must fix defects, redo services, refund, or let Dragon Systems withhold payment if it fails to perform. MMI must indemnify Dragon Systems for losses caused by MMI and protect Dragon Systems from patent or copyright claims relating to the services. Both sides must keep confidential information secret, Dragon Systems licenses MMI to copy master materials as needed for forecasts, and either side may end the contract immediately for material breach, merger/control changes, or bankruptcy, while Dragon Systems may also terminate without cause on 60 days' notice. The agreement is governed by Massachusetts or Dutch courts, and MMI must insure Dragon Systems property in its care and notify Dragon Systems of any loss or damage.
